notes.title: Yacht Dice 2.0 Preview And Progress
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm currently updating the code and interface of the game. Has the following:
[h1]Preview:[/h1]
1. A new match mode
[list]
[*] It allows you to match while playing a single player game, and you can choose to start the game at any time after matching the player.
[*] Multiplayer mode for 2-4 people, no longer limited to 2 people.
[/list]
2、A new user interface
[list]
[*] Allows you to view player information in the room while playing the game, or enable matchmaking in single player mode.
[*] Added quick match button.
[/list]

[h1]The progress of the new version:[/h1]
I've done most of the changes so far, but it will take some time to wrap things up. Originally, I thought the revision would be completed in two weeks, but the workload exceeded my expectations, so it needed to be delayed for a while.

notes.title: Game Little Update 03 and subsequent updates.
notes.notes:
1. Fixed Bug: Players in China may not be able to enter the room correctly due to the speed of the lobby data setting, so updated the room entry logic.
2. The dice will enter the grid automatically after the last roll.
3. Since there may be bugs when players of different versions play together, the new version reminder will pop up to remind players to update when players are in the same room with different versions.
4. Follow-up update plan (updated in these two days) :
(1) Add options in the room to adjust the time of each turn.
(2) Added the option to roll dice use the mouse moving instead of the button.

I have been trying to add new content, but I am only one person, it is not easy to add new content, so please understand me, I will do my best, thank you for your support :D.
